random_forest.note: Soft-vote the 5 forests (or use rf_final for a single model). Headline classifier + reject gate.

cnn.note: 5-fold soft-vote ensemble = the deployment CNN. Secondary model; softmax is NOT calibrated for a reject option (AUROC 0.836) -- temperature-scale before using as confidence.

reject_rule: if max RF class probability < 0.89: predict 'UNKNOWN' (not one of the six). Keeps 97.6% of real plastics (100% correct) and rejects 96.5% of OOD.
